images.title: A crease makes a segment
images.purpose: Show that a folded paper crease is straight with two end points A and B.
images.composition: One plain rectangle of paper with a single straight crease, centred, lots of white space.
images.exact_structure: One plain light rectangle outline (paper). Across its middle, one straight teal #0072B2 horizontal crease with a dot at each end, left labelled A and right labelled B. Exactly 1 paper, 1 crease, 2 end points.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A crease is straight and has two end points.
images.description: A paper rectangle with one straight teal crease whose two end points are labelled A and B.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the two end points and say the name AB.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
